May regulate the expression of many other genes inclusing genes with products in 8 mutually connected metabolic pathways: (1) starch and sucrose metabolism; (2) glycolysis/glucanogenesis; (3) TCA Cycle; (4) butanoate metabolism; (5) pyruvate metabolism; (6) aromatic amino acid and QA metabolism; (7) valine, leucine, and isoleucine degradation; and (8) transport of sugars and amino acids (PubMed:17597928, PubMed:21695121)
